findings.text: test_3z_dispatch_json_has_plan_path_and_report_lists_it only asserts the bare substring 'plan_path' somewhere in the Step 2A section and anywhere in Phase 4. It would still pass if plan_path were dropped from the JSON template literal (the `\"plan_path\": \"\"` field) but left in the explanatory prose, and the Phase 4 check does not tie it to the per-slice report next to docs_read.

findings.ac: AC1: AC -> test check wording (mechanical check)
findings.text: test_plan_phase_mechanical_check_uses_repo_test_paths asserts only 'git ls-files' and 'Every AC needs a planned test path matching'. The other half in 3d Phase 0.5 ('every planned test path must match one', the case behind the BT-221 nonexistent-test-path defect) and 'Any miss -> fix the plan before Phase 1' have no assertion.

findings.ac: Path: 3d Phase 3 compares coverage map with plan and writes deviations
findings.text: test_phase_3_compares_coverage_map_with_plan_and_writes_deviations checks only that '## Deviations' and the plan file literal appear somewhere in Phase 3. Nothing asserts the compare step itself (coverage map vs the plan's AC -> test list), the 'none' fallback, the skip-when-Phase-0.5-skipped clause, or that Done step 4 now references 'step 7' after renumbering (a stale 'step 6' reference would pass).

findings.ac: Mental model: skip only cosmetic (Fast-Track B)
findings.text: test_plan_phase_persists_plan_and_skips_only_cosmetic asserts only that 'Fast-Track B' and 'cosmetic' appear anywhere in the Phase 0.5 text. Rewording 'Skip only a pure cosmetic slice' to a broader skip condition would still pass, so 'skip ONLY cosmetic' is not pinned.
